definitions.explanation: The act of hiding and waiting to surprise or attack someone. Used in military, criminal, and everyday contexts such as waiting to catch someone off guard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せ⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We were ambushed by the enemy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police lay in wait for the criminal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せ⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}かされた→驚かす：01918_odorokasu⟧。
examples.english: I was startled by a friend who had been lying in wait for me on the way home.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (waiting) and {伏|ぶ}せ (lying face down, hiding). Literally "waiting while hiding." Can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb ({待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ambush, to lie in wait
- {待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be ambushed
- {待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: ambush attack

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奇襲|きしゅう}→奇襲：12193_kishuu⟧: surprise attack — a military term emphasizing the sudden, unexpected nature of the attack
- ⟦{伏兵|ふくへい}→伏兵：21099_fukuhei⟧: hidden troops, dark horse — soldiers lying in ambush, or figuratively an unexpected competitor
- ⟦{不意打|ふいう}ち→不意打ち：16416_fuiuchi⟧: surprise attack, catching off guard — emphasis on the target being unprepared
